output.review_comment: Request changes: (1) No PR description provided to explain the rounding logic; (2) The two-step rounding to 0.05 then 0.1 appears test-specific and lacks justification against the storage team spec; (3) The overflow handling loop seems engineered for specific edge cases rather than being a principled solution; (4) No evidence that tests actually pass. Please provide: a PR description explaining why this approach was chosen, confirmation that the full test suite passes, and justification for the specific rounding strategy if it differs from the original behavior.
